images.source_description:
have you ever gotten a hershey's bar that looked old? this one i opened today looked awful. i haven't even tasted it... not sure if i want to. it's not even brown, it's more like a beigey color... the date says june 2008. i've never seen one look like this before.
i went to hersheys.com and found this:
Q.My chocolate sometimes turns tan or white. What causes this?

A. Chocolate contains cocoa butter, a vegetable fat that is sensitive to heat and humidity. Temperatures above 75°F will cause chocolate to melt. The cocoa butter can rise to the surface and form a discoloration called "cocoa butter bloom." Condensation on milk or semi-sweet chocolate may cause the sugar to dissolve and rise to the surface as "sugar bloom." Chocolate that has "bloomed" is certainly safe to use, but flavor loss and texture changes may be noticed.

images.title: File:DSC 9844 Cozy cafe interior with warm hanging wicker lamps neatly arranged shelves of treats and inviting wooden seating.jpg
images.source_description: This appears to be the interior of a modern casual restaurant or café with distinctive Asian-fusion design elements. The space features beautiful woven bamboo or rattan lampshades hanging from the ceiling, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere with their soft lighting. The ceiling also has industrial-style fans and air conditioning units. The establishment appears to have a retail section with shelves displaying various products, possibly drinks or packaged foods in colorful containers. The interior combines modern industrial elements (like exposed pipes and metal fixtures) with natural materials (wooden walls and flooring). The seating area includes what looks like bench-style seating arrangements, and there's a "ZAKS HIGH" sign visible on the wall, which might be the name of the establishment. The overall design aesthetic combines contemporary urban style with traditional Asian elements, creating a cozy and stylish dining environment.
images.content_note_vi: Đèn đan đang dùng trong quán; khác ảnh sản phẩm nền trơn.
